name: Marel E. Bunker Roth
occupation: Platte County attorney-elect taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Marel E. Bunker Roth is the Platte County attorney-elect and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Douglas W. Weaver (also listed as Doug Weaver), who is serving through the current term. The official 2026 general election results list her as the winner of the attorney race.
